params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} deal {{tip|critical strike|{{as|10%|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}.
params.notes:
* The '''bonus''' damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.
* The '''bonus''' damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{sti|{{as|life steal}}}}.
* If the ''critical strike'' is {{as|magic damage}} then ''Vow of the First Lands'' amps it directly. Otherwise, it deals it as a new instance of {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} tagged as having ''critically struck''.
** When dealt as a new instance, it can ''critically strike'' again (e.g {{ii|Shadowflame}}), successivelly causing ''Vow of the First Lands'' to apply again on itself as an amp. {{bug|2}}
<!-- Blurb -->

description.plain: Innate: Yunara's critical strikes deal 10% (+ 10% per 100 AP) bonus magic damage.

blurb.plain: Innate: Yunara critical strikes deal bonus magic damage.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unleash'' for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against {{tip|champions}}. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the duration.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, dealing {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time, and an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
Each spread attack {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will {{tip|critically strike}} if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against {{tip|minions}} {{as|below 30% '''maximum''' health}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Active Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|3 to 23}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Combined Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|3+3 to 23+23}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''Cultivation of Spirit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the spread attacks.''
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|10000|Empowered attack missile speed}}|{{tt|2000|Spread attack missile speed}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' damage classifications:
** {{tip|Proc damage}} for the passive and active on-hit damage.
** {{tip|Basic damage}} for the spread attack damage.
* The ''on-hit'' will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for 0% '''bonus''' damage when the triggering attack does, causing it to be reduced by {{ii|Randuin's Omen}} but not be amped by {{ai|I|Yunara}}. {{bug|2}}
* Spread attacks will still deal damage even if '''Yunara''' misses her basic attack due to {{tip|blind}}.
* {{Pending for test}} Spread attack interaction with parrying effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}})
* There is no limit to the number of enemies the empowered attacks can spread to.
* '''Yunara's''' secondary resource bar gives various context for ''Cultivation of Spirit''. It is visible to the player only.
** While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is not active, the bar shows her current ''Unleash'' stacks. It is colored white while below maximum stacks and yellow while at maximum stacks.
** After ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is cast, the bar counts down the buff's duration.
*** This is also true during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara}}, which means that the bar effectively also counts down the duration of her ''Transcendent State''.
* If '''Yunara''' begins an {{tip|attack windup}} toward the end of the active effects' duration and its launch would take place after it, the effects' duration is extended equal to the attack's windup time, once at most.
** Since the buff ends right after launching ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' attack and its effects have already been determined, this allows it to both spread to nearby enemies and generate a stack of ''Unleash''.
* Each bolt from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} may trigger its own spread attack (despite the spread attacks not being an on-hit effect).
params.tips:
* While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' has no cooldown, the ability has a minimum downtime that is the time it takes for '''Yunara''' to generate 8 stacks.
** Against champions, this downtime is {{fd|{{#expr:4*1/{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}} round 2}}}} seconds at '''Yunara's''' base attack speed ({{as|{{fd|{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}}}}|attack speed}}), 20 seconds at minimum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}), and {{fd|1.{{Recurring|33}}}} seconds at maximum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|3.003}}|attack speed}}).
** Against non-champions, this downtime is {{fd|{{#expr:8*1/{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}} round 2}}}} seconds at '''Yunara's''' base attack speed ({{as|{{fd|{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}}}}|attack speed}}), 40 seconds at minimum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}), and {{fd|2.{{Recurring|66}}}} seconds at maximum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|3.003}}|attack speed}}).
** These can be further decreased with effects that allow exceeding the attack speed cap or reset the attack timer.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Yunara}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} and generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Unleash'' {{tip|on-attack}}, stacking up to a cap upon which she can cast ''Cultivation of Spirit''.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for a few seconds: her basic attacks gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, and spread to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies near the target.
params.blurb4: The spread attack will apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}}.

description.plain: Passive: Yunara's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Unleash for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against champions. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every 0.5 seconds after the duration.

description2.plain: Active: Yunara unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining bonus attack speed, dealing additional bonus magic damage on-hit, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower windup time, and an uncancellable windup. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing 30% AD physical damage. Each spread attack applies life steal and on-hit effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will critically strike if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against minions below 30% maximum health.

description3.plain: Cultivation of Spirit resets Yunara's basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be visible to be hit by the spread attacks.

blurb.plain: Passive: Yunara basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit and generate stacks of Unleash on-attack, stacking up to a cap upon which she can cast Cultivation of Spirit.

blurb2.plain: Active: Yunara unleashes for a few seconds: her basic attacks gain bonus attack speed, deal additional bonus magic damage, and spread to deal physical damage to enemies near the target.

blurb4.plain: The spread attack will apply life steal and on-hit effects, and can critically strike.

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' launches a spinning prayer bead in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}} as it travels. The bead slows down significantly while colliding with an enemy, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration; upon reaching maximum range, it will expand and linger in place for 1 second regardless of enemies hit.

The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While lingering, the bead deals 15% of the impact damage as {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.description2: ''Arc of Judgment'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 3|1;9;13|key=%}} damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect.
params.cast time: {{pp|0.45 to 0.225 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|label1= Bonus AS|color=attack speed|round=3}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the initial hit and {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the lingering effect.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the initial hit or one damage tick of the lingering effect.{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Arc of Judgment'' can hit an enemy more than once with the initial damage as well with the lingering effect (both while not expanded and while expanded).
** The bead can hit an enemy multiple times if they collide with it again while it is in flight.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yunara}} launches a spinning prayer bead that briefly slows down upon hitting an enemy. The initial hit against each enemy deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slows}} the target, and the bead continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: Upon reaching maximum range, the bead expands and lingers briefly.

The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals magic damage and slows them by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. While lingering, the bead deals 15% of the impact damage as magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds.

description2.plain: Arc of Judgment deals 50% – 100% (based on level) damage against minions and executes them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' fires a beam of spirit magic in the target direction that deals {{pp|160 to 480 for 3|1 to 3|type=[[File:Yunara Transcend One's Self.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Transcend One's Self's'' Rank|label1=Rank|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over 1 second, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}}.
params.description2: ''This ability {{tt|benefits from ultimate ability effects|See notes}} and is the upgraded version of {{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}} during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara|Transcendent State}}.''
params.cast time: {{pp|0.6 to 0.45 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|label= Bonus AS|color=attack speed}}
params.notes:
* ''Arc of Ruin'' grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings during the cast time and for {{tt|{{fd|0.3}} seconds|Estimated}} afterwards.{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The cooldown of ''Arc of Ruin'' can be reduced by any item or rune that reduces ultimate cooldown.
* The damage of ''Arc of Ruin'' is considered ultimate damage for the purposes of {{Iis|Malignance}} {{nie|Hatefog}} and {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}}.
* ''Arc of Ruin'' does not trigger ultimate ''cast'' effects, such as {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} and {{bi|Cloud Dragon Soul|possessive=true}} increased movement speed.
** {{note|2}} This is intended.
<!-- Blurb -->

params.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' enters ''Transcendent State'' for 15 seconds, during which each of her basic abilities is empowered:
{{lc|{{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}}} Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to ''Transcendent State's''.
{{lc|{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
{{lc|{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|cooldown}} reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
params.notes:
* An ongoing ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' effect is not lost when quickly replaced by ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.
* {{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}} is cast alongside ''Transcend One's Self''. If the former was not already active, this will also grant its {{tip|basic attack reset|attack reset}}.
** The attack reset does '''not''' originate from ''Transcend One's Self'' nor is ''Transcend One's Self'' tagged as granting one itself (e.g. for the purposes of {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
* ''Transcend One's Self'' cannot be cast again while active.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' damage and {{ais|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}} dash speed are increased.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Transcendent State:}} '''Yunara''' gains ''{{ais|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}'' active effect, ''{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' are upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.
params.blurb4: ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ais|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}'' cooldowns are reset and reduced, respectively, upon both entering and exiting the state.

description.plain: Passive: Arc of Ruin base damage and Untouchable Shadow dash speed scale with Transcend One's Self's rank.

description2.plain:

Cultivation of Spirit Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to Transcendent State's.
Arc of Judgment Upgraded into Arc of Ruin, which has no cost and has its remaining cooldown reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
Kanmei's Steps Upgraded into Untouchable Shadow, which has no cost and has its cooldown reset upon both entering and exiting the state.

blurb.plain: Passive: Arc of Ruin damage and Untouchable Shadow dash speed are increased.

blurb2.plain: Active: Yunara enters Transcendent State for some time.

blurb3.plain: Transcendent State: Yunara gains Cultivation of Spirit active effect, Arc of Judgment and Kanmei's Steps are upgraded into Arc of Ruin and Untouchable Shadow.

blurb4.plain: Kanmei's Steps and Arc of Judgment cooldowns are reset and reduced, respectively, upon both entering and exiting the state.
